source.title: A Trend Factor for the Cross Section of Cryptocurrency Returns
source.publication: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis 60(7), 2025

hypothesis: A simple, preregistered multi-horizon price-and-volume trend composite captures a tradable subset of the published CTREND mechanism in liquid Binance perpetuals without fitting a high-capacity model.
implementation_deviation: This is deliberately a low-capacity CTREND-lite proxy, not an attempted reproduction of the paper's machine-learning model. It averages fixed cross-sectional ranks of 7d, 30d, 90d price momentum and a 7d-vs-30d quote-volume trend.
universe: Each Monday 00:00 UTC, eligible Binance USD-M USDT perpetuals with at least 91 complete prior UTC days and valid features; keep top 30 by lagged trailing-30d quote volume. No future-survival filter.

features.volume_trend: lagged mean quote volume over prior 7 complete days divided by lagged mean over prior 30 complete days minus 1
features.composite: equal-weight average of within-date percentile ranks of 7d, 30d, 90d momentum and volume trend

portfolio: Equal-weight long top composite quintile and short bottom composite quintile, 0.5 gross per side.
rebalance: Weekly Monday 00:00 UTC; execute at current Monday open using information through prior completed day.
development_gate: mean weekly cross-sectional rank IC > 0.02 with positive long-short return and net portfolio Sharpe > 0.70
success_gate: OOS net Sharpe > 1.0, positive at 2x costs, 2024 and 2025 non-negative, max drawdown <35%, one-week extra execution delay positive, excluding BTC/ETH positive
notes: Top20 Donchian timed out and is counted as a trial. The externally frozen four-asset trend was also executed and rejected, bringing the global previous-trial count to 70. This candidate remains fixed before any result is observed.
